description: No credential or login required. Get form attachments. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

atfl_id.description: Attachment file ID (첨부파일 ID). Obtain from forms.list.

bbs_id.description: Board ID (게시판 ID). Obtain from forms.list.

current_page_no.description: List page the target row was found on. Optional; defaults to 1.

pst_sn.description: Post serial number (게시 일련번호). Obtain from forms.list.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
